events.title: Bert Bos joins CSS development
events.summary: Bert Bos joined Håkon Wium Lie at INRIA in July 1995 to co-develop Cascading Style Sheets — merging his Stream-based Style Sheet Proposal with Lie's CSS draft.
events.about: Bos had been building Argo, a browser with style sheet support, when he responded to Lie's October 1994 proposal on www-talk. The two met at WWW3 in Darmstadt that April and spent the summer at INRIA hammering out the cascading model that became CSS1. Bos is credited as co-creator alongside Lie.

narrative.whyChosen: CSS needed a second architect to turn a CERN proposal into a implementable standard.
narrative.whyImportant: Bos brought browser implementation experience and helped unify competing style sheet proposals at the W3C.
narrative.problemSolved: Multiple incompatible style sheet languages threatened to fragment how the web handled presentation.
